journal_lines: Creeper behind a tree. Backed up fast.
Spotted it before it spotted me. Barely.
Quiet and green. Made noise before it could.
It was standing still. Green. Hissing. Sprinted.
Heard the hiss and nothing else. Very fast.
Dark green in daylight. Harder to spot.
Found it before it could ignite. Barely.
Three of them. Two were already lit. Ran first.
The cat nearby distracted it. Grateful.
Backed into one. Left before the outcome.
Moving one away from the camp before it could wake anyone.
The explosion took the tree. Not me.
It was behind the boulder. The boulder's not there anymore.
Found it with my nose. Sidestepped in time.
Stood absolutely still. It waited. I didn't.
